text:
olivia: Heads up - release cut PR #412 stuck. harness/integration job failing 3/5 flakes with:

`````
ERROR: multipart upload aborted: s3 PutObject part failed: 503 SlowDown
Cache restore TTL expired for key: ci/harness/cache/sha256:abcd1234
`````

Deploy-bot paused promotion: https://deploybot/release/2026-03-23/PR-412 :eyes: Any suggestions? Do we pin to last-good or rerun the jobs?

sam: saw this. seems like S3 throttling + cache TTL expiry. rerun tends to unstick but we hit same 503 sometimes. Could try `DEPLOYBOT_CACHE_BYPASS=1` on canary.

maya: I'm leaning manual promote to last-known-good image to avoid blocking the window. we can backfill a fix. what's the rollback risk?

ryan: manual promote is safest for customer-facing. but if we manual promote, we should document in release notes and create postmortem ticket. we need to ensure data migration isn't affected (none for this change).

olivia: deploy-bot said it paused auto-promote because 2/3 smoke failed. status: deploy-bot: promotion paused due to failing canary. logs linked. We have a 2-hour change window; would prefer minimal churn.

ci-infra-bot: infra note — S3 region is reporting request rate spikes. Recommend throttling back parallel cache restores (reduce concurrency from 10->4) + increase cache TTL to 1h for next transient.

sam: ok plan: (1) manual promote last-good image (sha:sha1:77ef) (2) re-run harness with cache_bypass=1 for diagnostics (3) open infra ticket to increase TTL and reduce parallelism (4) schedule a follow-up canary after fix. :white_check_mark:

maya: +1 for that. who will run the manual promote?

ryan: I can do the manual promote now. ping me when you push the last-good tag.

olivia: tagging last-good now: `release-2026-03-23-canary:sha1-77ef` :ship: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Manual promote invoked by ryan. Promotion started... Promotion complete. :white_check_mark:

olivia: running reruns with cache_bypass=1 now, kicking off 3 sequential harness runs.

sam: put a short blurb in the release notes: 'Deployment promoted to last-known-good due to CI artifact cache transient errors; hotfix planned.' I'll open the infra ticket and link here.

ci-infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-6234 created: 's3 cache TTL and restore concurrency tuning' assigned to infra-team. ETA triage 24h.

maya: thanks. we'll rollforward patch once infra confirms. moving to unblock the release. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia: marking release as UNBLOCKED in the dashboard. cheers everyone, follow-up PR for TTL changes to come.
